findings.buyer_expectation: Buyers expected the bag to be waterproof or protect contents in rain, but reviews report wet contents after rain; the listing mentions water resistance but wording may be misunderstood.
findings.merchant_question: Bisa konfirmasi detail ketahanan air produk ini: apakah hanya tahan cipratan tanpa penutup/rivet anti-hujan, atau ada lapisan/finish khusus yang menahan hujan ringan?

text: Panjang kabel: panjang kabel 1 meter.

findings.buyer_expectation: Buyers expect the listing to state the cable length or offer length options so they know whether it will reach between devices.
findings.draft_text: Panjang kabel: panjang kabel 1 meter.
findings.merchant_question: Berapa panjang kabel (dalam meter) untuk unit yang Anda jual, dan ada pilihan panjang lain di stok?

findings.buyer_expectation: Buyers expect the listing to state the cable length (meters); multiple buyers received a short cable and say length was not listed.
findings.merchant_question: Berapa panjang kabel (dalam meter) yang disertakan untuk varian yang Anda jual?

text: Maksimal ketebalan kasur yang muat: cocok untuk kasur 160 x 200 cm dengan tebal maksimal 20 cm.

findings.buyer_expectation: Buyers need a clear maximum mattress thickness so they know whether the fitted sheet will fully cover their mattress.
findings.draft_text: Maksimal ketebalan kasur yang muat: cocok untuk kasur 160 x 200 cm dengan tebal maksimal 20 cm.
findings.merchant_question: Berapa ketebalan kasur maksimum (dalam cm) yang bisa ditutup rapat oleh sprei ini?

findings.buyer_expectation: Listing says 'model karet keliling' which implies the elastic reaches and secures all corners, but buyers report the elastic does not reach corners on thicker mattresses.
findings.merchant_question: Apakah karet keliling pada produk ini dirancang untuk menutupi sudut kasur hingga tebal berapa cm?

findings.buyer_expectation: Buyers want the listing to state the maximum mattress thickness (in cm) that the fitted sheet with elastic will fully cover.
findings.merchant_question: Berapa ketebalan kasur maksimal (dalam cm) yang dapat ditutup rapat oleh sprei ini dengan karet keliling?

findings.attribute: full ingredient list, including alcohol presence
findings.attribute_local: daftar kandungan lengkap, termasuk keberadaan alkohol
findings.buyer_expectation: Buyers need a complete ingredient list and explicit info about alcohol because some are allergic and/or notice a strong alcohol smell.
findings.merchant_question: Produk ini mengandung alkohol (jenis dan konsentrasi)? Tolong kirimkan daftar komposisi lengkap yang tercantum pada kemasan.

findings.buyer_expectation: Buyers expect a full ingredient list and explicit statement whether the product contains alcohol or common allergens so they can avoid reactions.
findings.merchant_question: Apakah produk ini mengandung alkohol (mis. alcohol denat) atau bahan pemicu alergi lainnya? Mohon cantumkan daftar lengkap bahan.

findings.buyer_expectation: Pesanan tiba sesuai estimasi singkat (beberapa hari) tanpa penundaan berhari-hari.
findings.merchant_question: Apakah Anda menggunakan jasa kurir tertentu atau pengiriman campuran, dan berapa rata-rata waktu pengiriman yang Anda lihat untuk kota-kota besar?

findings.buyer_expectation: Buyers expect to receive the variant they ordered.
findings.merchant_question: Bagaimana proses pengecekan varian sebelum dikirim?

text: Tipe konektor: konektor jack 3,5 mm; tidak ada versi USB-C atau Lightning.

findings.buyer_expectation: Pembeli mengira earphone bisa langsung dipakai di perangkat tanpa adaptor (contoh: iPhone 15 atau perangkat USB-C).
findings.draft_text: Tipe konektor: konektor jack 3,5 mm; tidak ada versi USB-C atau Lightning.
findings.merchant_question: Konektornya tipe apa persisnya (3.5mm TRS, Lightning, atau USB-C)?

findings.buyer_expectation: Buyers expect to know which connector the earphones use (3.5mm jack, USB-C, or Lightning) so they can determine compatibility with their phone without needing an adapter.
findings.merchant_question: Jenis konektor apa yang disertakan dengan earphone ini (3.5mm jack / USB-C / Lightning)?

text: Panduan ukuran: panjang insole: 39 = 25 cm; 40 = 25,5 cm; 41 = 26 cm; 42 = 26,5 cm; 43 = 27 cm; 44 = 27,5 cm.

findings.buyer_expectation: Buyers expect a size chart or guidance (e.g. fits true-to-size, inner length, fit for wide/narrow feet) so they can choose the correct number.
findings.draft_text: Panduan ukuran: panjang insole: 39 = 25 cm; 40 = 25,5 cm; 41 = 26 cm; 42 = 26,5 cm; 43 = 27 cm; 44 = 27,5 cm.
findings.merchant_question: Apakah Anda bisa menyediakan tabel ukuran (panjang insole/mm untuk setiap nomor) atau keterangan apakah produk ini fit true-to-size, besar, atau kecil?

findings.attribute: heel fit / slipper slips off heel
findings.attribute_local: longgar di tumit / mudah lepas di tumit
findings.buyer_expectation: Buyers expect the slide to stay on the foot while walking and not slip off at the heel.
findings.merchant_question: Apakah ada variasi lebar atau cetakan mould di bagian tumit yang menyebabkan beberapa ukuran terasa longgar?

findings.attribute: wrong variant sent / incorrect size in parcel
findings.buyer_expectation: Buyers expect to receive the exact size they ordered.
findings.merchant_question: Bisa cek proses pengemasan: apakah ada masalah packing/labeling untuk size 42 sehingga pelanggan menerima size 44?

findings.attribute_local: bau karet / petunjuk penjemuran sebelum dipakai
findings.buyer_expectation: Buyers expect either no strong chemical smell or guidance to remove smell before first use.
findings.merchant_question: Apakah produk baru biasanya berbau karet saat keluar pabrik, dan apakah Anda dapat menambahkan saran penjemuran atau ventilasi sebelum penggunaan?

findings.buyer_expectation: Buyers expect delivery within a reasonable timeframe (not excessively long).
findings.merchant_question: Apakah Anda bisa konfirmasi estimasi pemrosesan dan pengiriman (lead time) yang biasanya terjadi untuk produk ini?

findings.buyer_expectation: Buyers expect a concrete size guide (cm for each numeric size) or fit recommendation so they can choose the correct size.
findings.merchant_question: Berapa panjang insole (cm) untuk setiap ukuran 39–44 yang tersedia?

findings.attribute: size consistency across units / manufacturing variability
findings.buyer_expectation: Buyers expect sizes to be consistent between units of the same nominal size; reviews show variation (some 41 fits, some 41 longgar).
findings.merchant_question: Apakah ada toleransi produksi (mm) untuk panjang/lebar insole per ukuran yang bisa dijelaskan atau dikendalikan?

findings.attribute: heel fit / tendency to slip off at the heel
findings.attribute_local: kesesuaian tumit / gampang lepas di tumit
findings.buyer_expectation: Buyers expect the slide to stay on the foot when walking; some report it is loose at the heel and comes off.
findings.merchant_question: Apakah pola cetakan/last untuk tumit dibuat longgar pada model ini atau ada variasi produksi yang menyebabkan kelebaran di tumit?

findings.buyer_expectation: Buyers expect the size they ordered to be shipped; at least one buyer received a different size than ordered.
findings.merchant_question: Dapatkah tim packing/logistik memeriksa catatan pengiriman untuk order yang mengeluh (pesan 42 dikasih 44) dan konfirmasi apakah ada masalah batch/labeling?

findings.buyer_expectation: Buyers may accept a temporary rubber smell but expect it to be manageable; one buyer reports odor that required airing.
findings.merchant_question: Apakah produk melewati proses penghilangan bau (off-gassing) sebelum dikirim atau ada rekomendasi untuk mengurangi bau saat diterima pelanggan?

findings.buyer_expectation: Buyers expect timely delivery; one review reports a one-week delivery time as a complaint.
findings.merchant_question: Apakah estimasi waktu pengiriman yang ditampilkan di toko sesuai dengan pengalaman pengiriman aktual (ada keterlambatan apa tidak)?
